questions.text: What is Samal Nurova's favourite hobby?
questions.hint: "My absolute favourite hobby is photography. I take photos every single day."

questions.text: Samal bought her Canon camera with her own money.
questions.hint: "My father gave it to me as a birthday present when I was 16."

questions.text: How many Instagram followers does Samal have?
questions.hint: "I currently have more than 1,400 followers — mostly students from WKU."

questions.text: Samal's biggest dream is to organise a solo photo ___ at WKU called "WKU Through My Eyes".
questions.hint: "My biggest dream is to organise a solo photo exhibition at WKU before I graduate."

questions.text: Where is Aibek Dosov from, and what does he study?
questions.hint: "My name is Aibek Dosov. I am from Pavlodar. I study History at WKU."

questions.text: Zarina uses a recipe book when she makes beshbarmak.
questions.hint: "She knows how to make beshbarmak, baursaks, and manty from memory — without a recipe!"

questions.text: What does Bekzat do every morning before breakfast?
questions.hint: "He wakes up early to run five kilometres before breakfast."

questions.text: How many times a week does Ainur visit the WKU library?
questions.hint: "She visits the WKU library three times a week and always borrows four or five books."

questions.text: On which days does Timur play basketball?
questions.hint: "I play basketball three times a week — Monday, Wednesday, Friday after class." — Timur.

questions.text: Timur plays video games before doing his homework in the evenings.
questions.hint: "I also play video games in the evenings when I finish homework." — after homework, not before.

questions.text: What type of video games does Timur prefer?
questions.hint: "Strategy games mostly — I love planning and thinking ahead." — Timur.

questions.text: Samal says photography IS her way of ___.
questions.hint: "Photography IS my way of relaxing!" — Samal.

questions.text: Both Samal and Timur go hiking on Sundays near Uralsk.
questions.hint: Timur: "I go hiking on Sundays." Samal: "I go hiking too! I take my camera on the trails."

questions.text: What does Timur offer to teach Samal at the end of their conversation?
questions.hint: "In the evenings I'll teach you my favourite strategy game." — Timur.

questions.text: Samal ___ her camera everywhere she goes.
questions.hint: Samal = She → carries. (carry → -ies because y after consonant)

questions.text: "Zarina cook beshbarmak every Sunday" is correct English.
questions.hint: Zarina = She → "Zarina cookS beshbarmak every Sunday." He/She/It always needs -s!

questions.text: Bekzat ___ (train) for two hours after every class.
questions.hint: Bekzat = He → trains. (train → trains, just +s)

questions.text: Zarina ___ a recipe — she makes beshbarmak from memory.
questions.hint: Zarina = She → doesn't + base form. Never "doesn't uses"!

questions.text: "___ Arlan wake up at 7 am every morning?" — "Yes, he does."
questions.hint: Arlan = He → Does he wake up...? (Does + base form)

questions.text: "What does Aibek ___ in his free time?" — "He plays guitar every evening."
questions.hint: After "does" → base form. "What does he DO?" — never "does".

questions.text: Which sentence is 100% correct?
opts: Ainur read books in five languages.
questions.hint: "goes" ✅ — go → goes for He/She/It. Others miss -s or use don't instead of doesn't.

questions.text: "Does Samal goes hiking every Sunday?" is correct English.
questions.hint: After Does → base form! "Does Samal GO hiking?" — never "goes" in a Does-question.

questions.text: What does "dedicated" mean?
opts: doing something only once or twice
giving a lot of time and effort to something you care about
questions.correct: giving a lot of time and effort to something you care about
questions.hint: "Bekzat is dedicated — he trains every single day." — dedicated = преданный делу.

questions.text: Aibek plays guitar every evening because it is very ___. It helps him forget about stress.
questions.hint: Relaxing = расслабляющий. "Playing guitar is very relaxing after a hard day."

questions.text: What is a "trail"?
opts: a flat area for playing sports
a path through the countryside for walking
a building where art is displayed
questions.correct: a path through the countryside for walking
questions.hint: Trail = тропа. "There are beautiful hiking trails near the city of Uralsk."

questions.text: "Leisure" means time when you are very busy with work and responsibilities.
questions.hint: Leisure = досуг — FREE time when you are NOT working or studying. The opposite of busy time.

questions.text: What does "inspiring" describe?
opts: something that makes you feel tired
something that makes you feel enthusiastic and creative
something that is boring and repetitive
questions.correct: something that makes you feel enthusiastic and creative
questions.hint: "Samal's photos are truly inspiring — they change how you see the world."

questions.text: Zarina makes beshbarmak without a ___. She knows it completely from memory!
questions.hint: Recipe = рецепт — instructions for preparing a dish. "She cooks without a recipe."

questions.text: What is an "audience"?
opts: the group of people who watch or listen to a performance
questions.correct: the group of people who watch or listen to a performance
questions.hint: "Aibek plays guitar for a small audience in the common room." — audience = зрители/слушатели.

questions.text: What does "rewarding" mean?
opts: giving satisfaction and a feeling it was worth the effort
questions.correct: giving satisfaction and a feeling it was worth the effort
questions.hint: "Learning guitar is challenging but very rewarding." — rewarding = стоящий/приятный.
